## Step-by-Step Solution

**Step 1: Determine how many towels she washes in one hour (one wash).**

Sanya washes **7 bath towels** per wash, and each wash takes **1 hour**.

**Step 2: Determine how many towels she washes in one day.**

She has **2 hours per day**, so she can complete 2 washes per day.

$$7 \times 2 = 14 \text{ towels per day}$$

**Step 3: Determine the number of days needed for 98 towels.**

$$98 \div 14 = 7 \text{ days}$$

## Conclusion

Sanya needs **7 days** to wash all 98 bath towels.

$$\boxed{7}$$
